answer: Reaching the mirror of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the mesa of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the reef re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
